trends: Agentic AI adoption by marketing teams jumped from 15% in 2024 to 45% in 2026 (Salesforce State of Marketing); top-performing SMB teams are nearly 2x more likely to use AI agents than underperformers — the adoption gap is now a live editorial angle with hard data.

B2B AI execution gap: 95% of B2B marketers use AI in some workflow in 2026 but only ~39% report genuine performance gains (MarketScale, 2026) — the gap is attributed to shallow prompting and workflow misuse rather than model limitations, a strong hook for data-led content.

GEO is hitting mainstream: Gartner projects 70% of local search queries will include an AI-generated answer by end of 2026; the smart-practitioner frame is now a 50/50 split with traditional local SEO — opening space for 'failure modes' and 'what not to do' content that doesn't yet exist.

AI Overviews are measurably cutting organic CTR by 18–47% depending on query type (Improvado, 2026), making proactive brand entity management — ensuring AI systems cite your business correctly before errors occur — an urgent new content category distinct from the reactive audit pieces already published.

MercadoLibre Ads and retail media networks (Meta Shops, TikTok Shop) are becoming the dominant e-commerce growth lever for LATAM SMBs in 2026; virtually no English-language SMB marketing content covers MercadoLibre Ads strategy with real campaign structure and ACOS benchmarks.
